title: NMO: Vanilla Network
description: NJU Minecraft Organization's official Minecraft server. A Chinese vanilla network with Survival, Creative Building, Minigames, and RPG. No mods required — join and play.
body:
NJU Minecraft Organization's official Minecraft server. A Chinese vanilla network with Survival, Creative Building, Minigames, and RPG. No mods required — just log in and play.

南大 Minecraft 协会（NMO）官方服务器，中文原版群组服，包含生存、建筑、小游戏与 RPG 玩法。无需安装模组，登录即玩。

**Survival** — Technical Minecraft with QoL plugins and plugin-added custom items.  
**Creative Building** — Free build and campus replica projects.  
**Minigames** — Village Defense, Hide and Seek, Werewolf/Mafia, CS:GO-style PvP, Bed Wars, SkyBlock, Tarkov-style extraction, and more.  
**RPG** — Pan Ling Gu Yu (盘灵古域).

**生存服** — 生电玩法，含 QoL 插件与自定义物品。  
**建筑服** — 自由建造与校园复原项目。  
**小游戏服** — 村庄保卫战、躲猫猫、狼人杀、CSGO、起床战争、天空方块、搜打撤等。  
**RPG服** — 盘灵古域。

Join our community! 欢迎加入！
